plans.idea: Left-aligned editorial column: the badge sits top-left, the large headline and subline sit on the same left edge below it, and the CTA closes the column, so every element shares one strong left axis and the content reads straight down.
A square take on the original banner: a big badge fills the left half and the headline, subline and CTA stack on the right, all sharing one left edge, centred vertically against the badge.

Headline first: a wide text band across the top carries a large two-line headline and its subline, with the badge as a brand sign-off bottom-left and the CTA bottom-right on the same baseline area, so the eye goes from message to brand to action.
